issues: Delivery contains multiple unreconciled versions: an audit, revision notes, and two full reports with contradictory search/screening counts (14 searches/40 records/38 unique vs 11/132/116; 30 vs 108 excluded).
The submission is truncated mid-sentence at the end of the second conclusion, so the actual final answer is incomplete.

The two model sources labeled abstract in the brief are reported as full_text without visible full-text excerpts or preservation evidence in the delivery; mustDo abstract-level recording is not independently verifiable.
Five additional sources beyond the seeded three are asserted as included with PMCIDs, but their preservation/role is not evidenced and search counts do not reconcile.
judge.rationale: The core question is answered and overlap correctly left unresolved with the necessary fields named, but the delivery is bloated and internally inconsistent, weakening usefulness and correctness. Evidence handling shows careful typing and a sound derived estimate, yet asserted preservation/audit cannot be verified and key numbers conflict. Safety framing is appropriately hedged and avoids practice-level advice. Overall quality is undermined by incoherent versioning and truncation.
